primary_models.verbatim_excerpt: We evaluated and compared the performance of four widely used LLMs (gpt-oss-120B, Llama-3.3-70B, Mistral-Small-3.2-24B, and Gemini-2.5-Pro) on the proposed tasks.

primary_dataset.verified_value: AVIATOR (35 attack / 32 benign sequences) & Caldera-derived dataset (two sets of 33 APT sequences for 2:1 and 10:1 benign-to-APT ratio settings, each comprising 20 adversary-profile sequences and 13 MITRE emulation-plan sequences [including 5 lateral-movement and 8 multi-stage attack sequences], plus 33 benign sequences)
verbatim_excerpts: AVIATOR contains logs for both attack and benign activity, from which we derive 35 attack sequences and 32 benign sequences.

In addition, we generated two sets of APT-labeled sequences derived from Caldera, each containing 33 sequences: a 2 : 1 benign-to-APT ratio setting ... and a 10 : 1 setting ... Each set comprises 20 sequences whose APT code snippets are derived from adversary profiles ... Each set also includes 13 sequences derived from MITRE emulation plans, consisting of 5 lateral-movement sequences (each with about 6 APT snippets) and 8 multi-stage attack sequences (each with roughly 25 APT snippets).

retrieval_and_architecture.verified_paradigm: Multi-stage prompting (detection, localization, TTP mapping) with static ATT&CK domain-knowledge prompt injection (No DK, Coarse DK of 203 techniques, Full Summarized DK of 203 techniques and 453 sub-techniques); no dynamic vector retriever (RAG left to future work).
verbatim_excerpts: We evaluate the benefit of incorporating MITRE ATT&CK technique descriptions as an external knowledge base by comparing performance across three settings: (1) no domain knowledge, (2) coarse-grained knowledge containing descriptions of the 203 techniques, and (3) full knowledge covering all 203 techniques and 453 sub-techniques.

In the future, we plan to evaluate an approach in which each LLM summarizes the MITRE ATT&CK techniques and sub-techniques to construct its own domain knowledge, and to explore the use of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to access the full MITRE knowledge base without the information loss inherent in LLM-generated summaries.

evaluation_metrics.verified_value: Sequence F1 / Precision / Recall; Snippet Pinpointing Precision / Recall; TTP Mapping MRR / HR / NDCG (Top-3, Top-10); Tagging Summary ROUGE-1 / BERTScore
source_locations: Section 5.5 (Evaluation of Tagging Summary), Table 6, pages 17-19

context_window_and_segmentation.verified_value: Section 4.1 (Context Building, page 8): each segment is capped at up to 70% of the model's context window, using iterative sequence segmentation (sub-sequences of 400 code snippets; 300 for Mistral-Small-3.2-24B) with summary propagation for sequences exceeding LLM context windows. Section 5.2 (APT Detection, page 14): gpt-oss-120B, Llama-3.3-70B, and Mistral-Small-3.2-24B use a 128k token context window with an effective 70% segment limit of ~89,600 tokens (Gemini-2.5-Pro uses a 1M token context window without segmentation). Section 5.2 (page 15): 13.8% on page 15 is the 4-1 majority voting consensus rate across 5 runs (76.3% 5-0 consensus, 13.8% 4-1 consensus, 10% 3-2 split), not a token count. Full raw MITRE ATT&CK knowledge base exceeds practical context limits without LLM summarization or RAG (Section 2.2 page 3, Section 5.4 page 16, Section 7 page 20).
source_locations: Section 2.2 (Challenges in Applying LLMs to APT Detection), page 3
